commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

90+4' 0 - 1 Isak Hien (Atalanta) manages to rise above the opponent's defenders to meet the well-taken corner kick with his head. His effort goes into the middle of the goal and past the helpless goalkeeper. What a finish!
90+4' Atalanta win a corner.
90+4' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+3' 10:18 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.

89' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
87' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

77' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
